_comment: Scranton — GENERATION B workbook. NOT YET IMPORTED. Read-only projection only. envelope is NOW SET (derived 2026-07-31 from the MSA county list, not from the observed bbox) — see _envelope_comment for the counties used, the derivation rule and the containment cross-check.
_metro_area_flag: RESOLVED by the owner 2026-07-31: metro_area is 'Scranton-Wilkes-Barre'. Roughly half these venues are in Wilkes-Barre, Kingston, Pittston, Plains, Dallas and Hazleton rather than Scranton, and metro_area is what mints the public URL (/courts/in/scranton-wilkes-barre) and what renders on the page. ASCII hyphen, matching the stored 'Reno-Sparks' and 'Greensboro-High Point' convention — an en-dash slugs identically but diverges from convention for no gain. The state is deliberately NOT carried here: metroLabel() renders `${metro_area}, ${state}` from a per-row state, so a state-suffixed value would render 'Scranton-Wilkes-Barre, PA, PA'.
_envelope_comment: Derived from the Scranton--Wilkes-Barre, PA MSA COUNTY LIST, not from the observed venue bounding box. The observed bbox is only a LOWER bound — it says where the venues we happened to find are, not where the metro is, so an envelope cut to it would reject a legitimate future venue near the metro edge. Envelope = the union of the OSM boundary-polygon bounding boxes for the 3 MSA counties (Lackawanna, Luzerne, Wyoming), Luzerne (Pennsylvania), Wyoming (Pennsylvania)), rounded OUTWARD to 0.01 deg. Cross-check: contains all 14 geocoded venue(s) of 18 in this batch (observed lat 40.9503..41.4763, lng -75.9794..-75.5829).
